live transcription, global search.
# dsh-legal-workbench

A right-sidebar workbench for DeepSeek Harness.
It turns your Obsidian notes into a working surface

inside the chat window: look up SOPs,
keep a glossary, record meetings with live transcription and a
nnotations, and search everything.
All files stay on your computer. No account, no telemetry. See PRIVACY.md.
中文说明见 README.zh.md。
## Install

**Requires** a DSH installation (0.2.0 or newer — check with `dsh --version`) and network access
(th
e package comes from npm).
Pick the command that matches your DSH:
**DSH Desktop app**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Self-hosted DSH Web** (on your server)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Using a custom profile name? Replace `desktop` / `web` with yours (see `~/.dsh/profiles/`).
Then **restart DSH** and click the workbench icon next to the session title, or press `⌥W`.
No Obsidian required, no API keys, no account.

> Fully verified on macOS only. Other platforms install and run, but the two actions that call
> sys
tem commands ("open in Obsidian", "open console") may need a config tweak.
## First run

Click the workbench icon next to the session title (or press `⌥W`).
The first time, it asks for one

thing: the full path of a folder holding your Markdown notes
(an Obsidian vault, or any folder — the

plugin only touches `.md` files).
Fill it in and press save — that's it.

Nothing else is required. The optional extras (transcription, usage badges, Pkulaw points)
stay dorm
ant until you provide your own credentials.
## What you get
| Card | What it does | Needs |

| SOP | Browse your SOP folder as a tree, read and edit notes in place | a vault |
| Glossary | One

row per term, edit inline, written back to a note | a vault |
| Recordings | Record, transcribe live
, highlight and annotate the transcript, play back | a vault; transcription needs a Volcengine key |

| Search | Full-text search across notes, transcripts and annotations | a vault |
| Email | Draft e

mails from your own rule library | optional: your own skill folder |
| Usage badge | DeepSeek balanc
e and remaining speech hours | optional: your own keys |
## Where things live

- Your notes and recordings: inside your vault (folders are configurable on the first screen).
- Plu

gin configuration: `~/.dsh-workbench/config.json`.
- Optional credentials: `~/.dsh-workbench/asr.jso
n` (mode 600, never in this repo).
## Keyboard

- `⌥W` — open or close the workbench wherever you are
- `Esc` — close it
## Notes

- The right sidebar is per-session in DSH. If the workbench cannot dock there, it opens as an
overla

y instead of failing silently.
- Transcription is off unless you configure a Volcengine key; recordi
ng and playback work without it.
## Troubleshooting

- **The panel opens but stays empty**: click the **refresh** button at the top right of the panel.
T

his is a known first-load issue in 1.1.0; one refresh fixes it.
- **Clicking the icon does nothing**

: some sessions have no right sidebar yet, so the workbench
opens as an overlay instead (shortcut `⌥

W`).
- **It asks you to configure something**: it just needs the folder holding your Markdown notes.

you to configure something**: it just needs the folder holding your Markdown notes.
Fill it in once.
## Known limitations

- **Images in notes are not rendered.** They appear as a filename label (e.g. `图片 photo.png`).
Every

thing else in a note (headings, lists, bold, code, tables as text, wikilinks) is shown.
- Markdown s

upport is deliberately minimal: no HTML, no embedded PDFs, no mermaid rendering.
- Annotations ancho

r to the **first line** of a multi-line selection.
- Highlight colour is fixed (yellow); the storage

supports more, the UI does not expose it yet.
- The reimbursement card only checks that a template

exists; it does not parse it yet.
- Transcribing an imported audio file shows no progress bar.
- The

workbench reads and writes the vault directly. Edits made in Obsidian appear after a refresh,
and e

dits made here appear in Obsidian immediately (same files).
- DSH gives each session its own right s

idebar; if the workbench cannot dock there it opens as an
overlay instead of failing silently.
